title: Documentation
description: Docs, guides and READMEs; no product code changes.

steps.title: Brief
steps.acceptance: Audience, pages to write or change, source of truth (code, issues) and repo are in the brief.

steps.title: Write
steps.acceptance: Pages written from the code and real commands; every command was executed or marked as untested.

steps.title: Review
steps.acceptance: Only documentation files changed; links resolve; examples match current code; no marketing filler.

security_rules: No secrets, tokens or `.env` content in code, commits, logs or screenshots.
Dependencies: pin versions, run the audit (`npm audit --omit=dev`), no new package without a stated reason.
Documentation-only: the diff must not touch source code, CI or config.
No real tokens, hostnames, emails or customer data in examples; use obvious placeholders.
Do not document insecure shortcuts (disabled auth, `--no-verify`) as recommended practice.
tech_stack: Short pages, one topic each, linked from `docs/README.md`
Code blocks tagged with a language; commands copy-pastable
Playwright only if screenshots are required
